🎬 Tulsa King (2022–Present) – Crime Drama

Dwight "The General" Manfredi is a ruthless New York mafia caporegime who is released from prison after serving a 25-year sentence, only to find that his loyal service has been rewarded with exile. Sent by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma, Dwight realizes that his old-school mob tactics have little place in the modern Midwest.

Determined to carve out a new future, Dwight begins building an unlikely crew from scratch, recruiting local misfits and business owners into a brand-new criminal empire. As he establishes his territory and navigates the eccentricities of Oklahoma, he must deal with vengeful federal agents, rival gangs, and the fallout from his past life back East.

The series explores themes of reinvention, loyalty, aging, culture clash, and second chances. Through Dwight's fish-out-of-water journey, Tulsa King highlights how an old dog can learn new tricks when forced to adapt to a completely foreign environment.

More than just a standard mob thriller, Tulsa King is an entertaining blend of grit and dark humor about starting over when the world has left you behind. Dwight's story proves that ambition has no expiration date, and that leadership can be forged anywhere if you have enough nerve.

💬 If you were forced to start completely over in a place you didn't belong, how would you rebuild your empire? 👇
